## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The `--exclude` environment default should be fixed so CI can configure exclusions through `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE`.

## Changes

This pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that filters files by name before archiving. It documents the flag and adds parser, collection, and archive tests.

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the exclude default from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude` argument, the archive still includes `skip.log` because the parser hard-codes `default=[]`. `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11` requires that “Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that set exclusions only through the environment produce archives containing files they intended to omit.
